body:
RUNNABLE REPRODUCTIONS for the four open correctness bugs, in one self-contained script.

I audited my own bug beads and found that three of four contain no self-contained setup -
they show symptoms and evidence but not code anyone could paste. That is precisely the
criticism I filed against this package's README (bd-01KZYBHKN8WYBVYCSJ4Z8HMZE8: illustrative
code typographically identical to runnable code) and against evidence-pairing.Rmd
(bd-01KZY94REFFH9DQDJG7TD2J7XJ: prose pointing at hidden setup). I did the same thing while
criticising it, which makes the queue I handed over harder to act on than it needed to be.

Fixed. The script below runs end to end from the package root and reproduces all four,
each block independent, each printing OBSERVED against EXPECTED. Verified at HEAD 4779aed.

Covers:
  BUG 1  bd-01KZYDTPTS6QPHCM07P1PPH396  cross_partitions(fit) -> 10 edges, should be 3
  BUG 2  bd-01KZY99TXMHQYMAYA4VQDZCWFD  as.matrix(view) -> 6x1 keeping the view class, then crashes
  BUG 3  bd-01KZYMN0A7F5C65TJN16T2WR91  regions() NA labels -> mass 0.5,0.5,0,1, silent
  BUG 4  bd-01KZYJAQ7Y06F5C1P7KG6MAJE4  the advice message -> fails twice; recipe vs fixed metric

-----BEGIN repro.R-----
# Self-contained reproductions for four open effectagram bugs.
# Run from the package root:  R -q -f repro.R
# Each block is independent; each prints OBSERVED vs EXPECTED.
suppressWarnings(pkgload::load_all(".", quiet = TRUE))
set.seed(1)

hdr <- function(x) cat("\n", strrep("-", 68), "\n", x, "\n", strrep("-", 68), "\n", sep = "")

## ---------------------------------------------------------------- BUG 1
## bd-01KZYDTPTS6QPHCM07P1PPH396
## cross_partitions() on a relation_fit pairs the fit's own structural fields.
hdr("BUG 1  cross_partitions(fit) enumerates the fit's own fields")
P <- 12; K <- 3; R <- 3; Tn <- 30
dom <- abstract_domain(P, coordinates = cbind(x = (seq_len(P) - 1) %% 4,
                                              y = (seq_len(P) - 1) %/% 4), id = "repro:v1")
cond   <- rep(seq_len(K), length.out = Tn)
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + factor(cond)); colnames(design) <- paste0("cond", seq_len(K))
Cm <- diag(K); rownames(Cm) <- colnames(design)
resp <- setNames(lapply(seq_len(R), function(r) matrix(rnorm(Tn * P), Tn, P)),
                 paste0("run", seq_len(R)))
fit <- lm_relation_fit(resp, design, Cm, domain = dom)

cat("names(fit)              :", paste(names(fit), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("nrow(cross_partitions(fit))          :", nrow(cross_partitions(fit)),
    "   <- OBSERVED (choose(5,2) = 10)\n")
cat("nrow(cross_partitions(fit$relation)) :", nrow(cross_partitions(fit$relation)),
    "   <- EXPECTED (choose(3,2) = 3)\n")
cat("NOTE: printing cross_partitions(fit) dumps ~80 KB of nested lists.\n")

## ---------------------------------------------------------------- BUG 2
## bd-01KZY99TXMHQYMAYA4VQDZCWFD
## as.matrix() on a view returns a corrupted object that crashes on print.
hdr("BUG 2  as.matrix(view) returns a corrupted object of the same class")
rel2 <- fit$relation
g2   <- geometry(plan_geometry(rel2, at = compile_frame(searchlights(1.5), dom),
                               over = cross_partitions(rel2)))
cat_rdm <- matrix(c(0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 0), 3, 3, byrow = TRUE,
                  dimnames = list(colnames(design), colnames(design)))
v2 <- rsa(g2, models = list(category = cat_rdm))
m2 <- as.matrix(v2)
cat("dim(as.data.frame(v2)) :", paste(dim(as.data.frame(v2)), collapse = " x "), "  <- correct\n")
cat("dim(as.matrix(v2))     :", paste(dim(m2), collapse = " x "),
    "  <- OBSERVED; coefficients are n x 2\n")
cat("class(as.matrix(v2))   :", paste(class(m2), collapse = ", "),
    "  <- OBSERVED; should not retain the view class\n")
cat("print(as.matrix(v2))   -> ",
    tryCatch({ print(m2); "no error" },
             error = function(e) paste("ERROR:", conditionMessage(e))), "\n")

## ---------------------------------------------------------------- BUG 3
## bd-01KZYMN0A7F5C65TJN16T2WR91
## regions() silently drops NA-labelled features and rescales survivors.
hdr("BUG 3  regions() silently drops NA labels and rescales regions")
dom3 <- abstract_domain(4, coordinates = cbind(x = 0:3, y = 0), id = "repro3:v1")
for (lab in list(c("r1", "r1", "r2", "r2"),
                 c("r1", "r1", NA,   "r2"),
                 c("r1", NA,   NA,   "r2"))) {
  f  <- compile_frame(regions(lab), dom3)
  cs <- Matrix::colSums(f$weights)
  cat(sprintf("labels %-18s rows=%d  feature mass=%-22s dropped=%d\n",
              paste(lab, collapse = ","), nrow(f$weights),
              paste(cs, collapse = ","), sum(cs == 0)))
}
cat("EXPECTED: a warning, or an explicit unlabelled= policy. Region r2 silently\n")
cat("          stops being mean(f3,f4) and becomes f4 alone - a different estimand.\n")

## ---------------------------------------------------------------- BUG 4
## bd-01KZYJAQ7Y06F5C1P7KG6MAJE4
## The one error message containing runnable code gives advice that fails.
hdr("BUG 4  R/crossnobis.R:230 advice does not work")
fr4 <- compile_frame(searchlights(1.5), dom); pr4 <- cross_partitions(fit$relation)
cat("the message you get:\n  ",
    tryCatch(plan_crossnobis(fit, fr4, pr4, metric = identity_metric()),
             error = function(e) conditionMessage(e)), "\n\n")
cat("following it literally:\n")
cat("  noise_precision(diag(P))            -> ",
    tryCatch({ noise_precision(diag(P)); "ok" },
             error = function(e) paste("ERROR:", conditionMessage(e))), "\n")
cat("  noise_precision(diag(P), domain=dom)-> ",
    tryCatch({ plan_crossnobis(fit, fr4, pr4, metric = noise_precision(diag(P), domain = dom)); "ok" },
             error = function(e) paste("ERROR:", conditionMessage(e))), "\n")
cat("what actually works:\n")
cat("  shrinkage_precision(0.2)            -> ",
    tryCatch({ plan_crossnobis(fit, fr4, pr4, metric = shrinkage_precision(0.2)); "ok" },
             error = function(e) paste("ERROR:", conditionMessage(e))), "\n")
cat("  diagonal_precision()                -> ",
    tryCatch({ plan_crossnobis(fit, fr4, pr4, metric = diagonal_precision()); "ok" },
             error = function(e) paste("ERROR:", conditionMessage(e))), "\n")
cat("\nCAUSE: noise_precision() builds a FIXED metric; plan_crossnobis() needs a RECIPE.\n")
-----END repro.R-----
